intro: The Ice Thistle Hills are a snow-covered highland rise lying just southeast of the goblin outpost of Everlook. Dominated by a rugged cavern system, the area is claimed by ferocious Ice Thistle yetis that threaten any travelers venturing off the main road.

p: Rising sharply out of the central drifts of Winterspring, the Ice Thistle Hills serve as the primary hunting grounds and nesting territory for the valley's aggressive Ice Thistle yetis. Centered around a prominent cave dug deep into the rockface, these hulking beasts roam both the rocky slopes and the winding tunnels within. Because of their proximity to Everlook, the yetis present a constant nuisance and danger to goblin commerce and visiting prospectors, who regularly commission intrepid hunters to cull the beasts for their valuable thick pelts and pristine horns.
